clinical_prerequisites: Diagnosis of lymphedema documented by the treating practitioner (MD, DO, NP, PA, CNS) in the beneficiary's medical record. This documentation cannot come from a licensed clinical medical practitioner (LCMP) such as physical therapist, occupational therapist, or lymphedema therapist even if the medical records are countersigned by the prescribing practitioner.

For supplies – In addition to the description of the base item, the DMEPOS order/prescription may include all concurrently ordered supplies that are separately billed (List each separately) Quantity to be dispensed, if applicable
